cases.name: Arlet Hernandez Conteras
cases.narrative:
After killing her and their two young sons, Limas let the bodies of Conteras and boys rot in a balcony closet for 10 days while he continued to go to dance clubs, rented limos, and even had friends over to his apartment, until 4/24/2012.

On 4/25/2012, her body was found inside a large chest, dumped in a Los Angeles County gutter. Her children’s bodies were never located.
